event_name: Football vs. UAB
event_description:
Battle for the Bones
A celebration of Memphis culture, community, and tradition.

One of college football's most unique rivalries returns to Memphis! The Tigers take on UAB with bragging rights and the iconic Bones Trophy on the line. Be there as Memphis looks to defend home turf and bring the Bones back where they belong!

Before kickoff, join the fun at our BBQ Cookoff Contest, featuring great food and some friendly competition as we celebrate one of the things Memphis does best: BBQ.

Come hungry, get loud and help the Tigers bring home the Bones!
